analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 31.8, a slight increase from 30.6 five days ago, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram at -9.3558 shows improvement. ADX at 26.2 indicates a clear trend, but the -DI (41.5) is higher than the +DI (14.9), suggesting downward pressure dominance. Trading volume is subdued at 0.27x the 5-day average. The 52-week position at 55.0% is neutral. As a 15-year swing trader, current indicators do not provide a clear buy/sell direction, making a wait-and-see approach rational.
